reasoning: 驗證目標：由緩衝區播放時，HU 提供前進音訊內容的方法（Fast Forward）。關鍵情境條件：播放位置在緩衝區內而非即時廣播——條文以「playing from the buffer」為前提。為什麼這樣切：本 leaf 的驗證對象是該方法存在且生效（播放位置前移），一條 TC 覆蓋單一觸發的必然結果。依 §8.2.1 與兄弟 leaf 劃界：前進的速率階梯由 090 覆蓋、到達即時廣播的結束行為由 089 覆蓋、即時廣播下嘗試前進的拒絕行為由 091 覆蓋、期間的靜音與功能暫停由 092 覆蓋——本 leaf 只驗方法本身。

tcs.tc_title: Fast forward advances playback while playing from the buffer
tcs.test_item: When playing from the buffer, the HU shall provide a method to advance in audio content (Fast Forward)
tcs.pre_conditions:
1. A SiriusXM signal source is available and the vehicle has an active subscription
2. The HU Satellite Audio source is selected on the Cabin Output Channel
3. The HU is tuned to a receivable Satellite Audio channel
4. The buffer holds several minutes of content
5. Playback is positioned inside the buffer, behind the real-time broadcast
tcs.test_procedure:
1. Read the playback position relative to the real-time broadcast
2. Request Fast Forward and hold it briefly
3. Release the Fast Forward request
4. Read the playback position relative to the real-time broadcast
tcs.expected_result:
1. The playback position is behind the real-time broadcast
2. The fast forward request is accepted and the playback position advances
3. The advance stops when the request ends
4. The playback position is closer to the real-time broadcast than it was in step 1
tcs.design_method: 功能測試 (Functional based ; no specific technique)
